title: Parity and Evenness of a Hanna Power Series: A Complete Proof and Lean 4 Formalization of OEIS A326602
description: A proof of Paul D. Hanna's 2019 parity conjecture for OEIS A326602, directly from its formal power series definition. A signed multinomial triple-sum expansion and coordinate-swapping involution establish evenness and show that the coefficient of x^(2n) is odd exactly when n is a square. Includes the manuscript, original Lean 4.33.1 proof bundle and reproduction instructions. The author reports zero sorry and standard axioms only; independent review and verification are pending. Developed with AI assistance.
